A '''member''' of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fighting for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="gar" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], serving as a [[Jedi General/Legends|general]] for the Republic, was [[Death/Legends|vaporized]] by Separatist fire during the [[Battle of Altyr V]]. Nevertheless, the [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] [[Deviss/Legends|Deviss]] took command of the Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] and managed to secure<ref name="gar" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Altyr system/Legends|Altyr system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Knight">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> [[Altyr V]] for the Republic.<ref name="gar" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi [[General/Legends|general]] was mentioned in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]]. The guide was published in [[Star Wars Insider 84|''Star Wars Insider'' 84]],<ref name="gar" /> which was released on [[September 13]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref>
